learner_operation: Separate, integrate both sides, invert, distinguish signed primitive coefficients in complete explicit solution families.

fixed_features.constant_inside_inverse: All candidate families use a free integration constant, so shape cannot identify the key.

roles: Every candidate coefficient can be correct with the same entire visible bank held fixed. Four families use a fixed palette; tangent also samples four peers from its seven-value legacy-compatible pool.

coverage.boundaries: h=-8,0,8; signed coefficients; affine intercept +/-3; tangent retains a=4,5. This is representative translation/intercept coverage, not enumeration of every parameter combination.

counterfactuals.relevant: Five families: change a=-1 to a=2 with bank, h and b held fixed. ODE, primitive, explicit solution and key change together; all response choices exercised through the native grader.
counterfactuals.irrelevant: Seed/choice order preserve prompt, solution and correct mathematical value. Temperature ambient 25->35 preserves its exponential blank factor, with both complete records natively graded.

generator_rejection: Signed coefficient peer banks always contain five distinct complete families; normal sampling makes no rejection/resampling pass. Existing non-easy operation-error banks retain equivalence rejection. No positive/negative case is filtered by the sampler.
selection: question_selection.rs was inspected read-only: difficulty weights choose an eligible band; within a positive-weight easy band the SHA256 draw is uniform over fresh candidates. There is no template/answer balancing. History removes candidates. No live history/weights/future entity IDs are available, so post-delivery reachability is structural, not a prediction for a learner.
limitations: Variation claims target the requested easy band; inherited moderate/hard scope was retained, with source replay, native grading and a small regression sample.
Observed source-bank replay retains historical arrangements and is not selected by normal generation.
Checks cover the stated cues and counterfactuals, not every conceivable strategy.
